Liam: Quick sync — we need final tenant provisioning checklist for Marketplace staging by EOD Fri. Press embargo is Thu 10am PT. Who owns tenant onboarding runbook updates?
Maya: I can take runbook edits. Will update steps and add screenshots. Need list of partner SIs that need early access.
Sana: Sending list now: CloudScale, NimbusSI, EdgeWorks. CloudScale wants early certs.
Oliver: For certs, we need onboarding API keys + VPC peering steps. @Priya can you confirm KMS/HSM notes for private deploy?
Priya: Confirmed. KMS section ready. I'll drop a short blurb for press about security posture.
Liam: Great. Also need landing page copy final by Wed. Marketing asked for 3 short blurbs + hero CTA A/B variants.
Maya: I'll slot copy reviews Wed 9am. Can we get product quotes from Eng by Tue?
Sana: I'll ping eng-rep in eng-platform channel.
Oliver: For SI rollouts, propose phased access: phase 1 = tenant provisioning + testdata, phase 2 = performance runs. Timeline in this thread.
Liam: Phase dates: phase1 start Tue 03/25, phase2 start Mon 04/07. Thoughts?
Priya: Works for security signoffs. Need 48h lead for compliance docs.
Maya: Noted. Also we should prepare press asset pack: logos, partner quotes, one-pager. @deploy-bot can you attach current logo zip?
deploy-bot: Attached: marketplace-logos-v3.zip
Sana: Sharing SI contact emails in private — done.
Oliver: Ops note: tenant provisioning Terraform snippet to create test tenant:
```
resource "redwood_tenant" "test" {
  name = "cs-demo-tenant"
  region = "us-west-2"
  plan = "dedicated"
}
```
Use env var REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Maya: Sweet. Action items: Maya(edit runbook), Oliver(TF + provisioning scripts), Priya(KMS + compliance blurb), Liam(press timeline + landing copy coordination), Sana(SI contacts + early access). Can we sync Thu 11am PT to confirm assets?
Liam: Thu 11am PT works for me. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll be there. :eyes:
Oliver: I'll bring the deployment checklist.
Maya: I'll send calendar invite in a bit.
Liam: Thanks team — we'll loop in marketing and legal after this sync.
